notes: Emsisoft deploy, three improvements. (1) Download installer button: on the result screen, 'Download installer to Downloads' saves the .exe straight to your Downloads folder with a progress bar and an 'Open folder' button — no browser, and it never auto-installs; you double-click to install. (2) Faster: the deploy no longer auto-searches for an existing workspace every time (that was slow when Emsisoft is busy) — there's now a 'Check for an existing workspace' button on the form to do it on demand. (3) Try again: when a deploy fails (e.g. Emsisoft's server times out), the result screen now has a Try again button that first checks whether the workspace was actually created before retrying, so you don't make duplicates.
